title: Call new sales leads and book meetings with a voice agent
summary: A user shows a video of ElevenLabs Agents phoning each new form lead within seconds, asking qualifying questions and booking a meeting.
agent_role: The voice agent calls the lead after a form is filled, asks qualifying questions and books the meeting; the human set up the flow.
what_they_did: The poster built a flow with ElevenLabs voice agents. When a lead fills out a web form, the agent calls them within seconds. It asks questions to judge fit and books a meeting. The flow was inspired by two other creators.
how_it_went: The poster shares a video demo and calls themselves a happy user, but gives no numbers.
worth_knowing: The poster says they are not affiliated with ElevenLabs. The demo shows the flow, not results from real leads.
prompt: When a new lead submits [your web form], call them within a minute using a friendly voice. Introduce yourself as calling from [business name]. Ask these qualifying questions: [budget], [timeline], [need]. If they fit [criteria], offer open slots from [my calendar] and book the one they pick. If not, thank them politely. After each call, write a short summary to [spreadsheet or CRM]. Before going live, show me the call script and run a test call to me for approval.

curation.rationale: A thin but genuine demo of a voice agent that calls new leads, qualifies them and books meetings; a video exists but few details or results are given.
